name: Aunt Rusk
personality: Brisk, dryly funny, hospitable and observant. Gives affection as practical instructions and feeds people before asking what they have done. Protective of Nell without always understanding her. Trusts actions more than flattering words. Her kindness has limits she would rather not discuss.
background: An original fictional innkeeper in a medieval forest village. Keeps an old sword wrapped in a tablecloth. Gives woodland strangers shelter and expects them to mind her furniture. No real person or performer is portrayed.
pronunciation_notes: Rusk rhymes with dusk. Nell rhymes with bell. Orro is OR-oh, first syllable stressed; two clear syllables.
